purpose: Postgres rules for schema design, RLS policies, migrations, indexes, and query diagnosis — load BEFORE writing anything that lives in Postgres.
use_when: Writing RLS policies so tenants only see their own rows, plus tests verifying them
Creating or altering tables, columns, migrations, indexes, triggers, or Postgres functions
Diagnosing slow queries, EXPLAIN plans, bloat, locking, or rows visible to the wrong tenant
do_not_use_when: Supabase product surface (Auth config, CLI, client libraries, Edge Functions) -> supabase skill
GPU, CUDA, or ML model work
scope: Only touch files the task names; everything else read-only.
disambiguator: Postgres rules and SQL/RLS authoring -> this. Supabase product surface (Auth, CLI, JS libs) -> supabase skill.
